description: Linux kernel driver source code for GCA230718 LED support via I2C, managing RGBW LEDs connected to the GCA230718 chip.

classes.name: gca230718_led
classes.description: Represents an individual LED connected via the GCA230718 driver, including brightness and I2C client info.

classes.name: gca230718_private
classes.description: Holds private data for the driver instance, including mutex lock and array of LEDs.

methods.name: gca230718_init_private_led_data
methods.description: Initializes the private data structure for LEDs, setting client pointers to NULL.

methods.name: gca230718_send_sequence
methods.description: Sends a sequence of commands over I2C to initialize or update LED states.

methods.name: gca230718_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of a specific LED and updates the hardware via I2C.

methods.name: gca230718_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver when the device is detected, sets up LEDs, and sends initial sequences.

methods.name: gca230718_remove
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the device is removed.
